review_type: Manual inspection of rendered images through the image viewer, alongside explicit SVG/topology checks.

observations.main_path: Five nodes on a single left-to-right baseline; every arrowhead points to the specified target.
observations.narrow_path: Top row runs left to right through Assay, then down to Analysis and left to Result.
observations.quality_control: Assay enters Quality control; dashed Recheck required feedback ends on Preparation.
observations.reference_database: Arrow ends on Analysis in both layouts; no edge connects database and Result.
observations.labels: All visible text labels are readable without truncation; two-line database label preserved.
observations.grayscale: Directions and feedback remain distinguishable through arrowheads, dashed stroke and condition text.
observations.correction: Both database cylinders enlarged to 21 mm height after the first preview to improve clearance above Reference.
observations.editability: Independent copy visibly displays Output in a green ellipse; original Result master remains unchanged.

limitations: 96 dpi previews do not prove exact physical on-screen size or replace a printed proof.
